أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «أبي (رحمه الله)» is the compiler's father, named by relation: relation, occurrence 1
«عن أبيه محمد بن خالد» is one link (rule 7): the name alone; «أبيه» occurrence 2 is the Imam's father, named by relation
the Imam named after «عن» («الصادق جعفر بن محمد») stays narrator (owner ruling 2); «آبائه» is a plural relation, the Imam's forefathers, unnamed by the text
«الشيخ الجليل», «(رضي الله عنه)», «(رحمه الله)» and «(عليهم السلام)» are left out; «217 / 1» is a number
the saying is Umm Salama's own account; she is the last link
